workflows.notes: 2026-05-13: merged old 04/05 into one pose folder. Post-merge smoke passed. Multi-character test found an important rule: shared auburn/orange donors transfer pose but contaminate other characters; character-specific donors preserve identity much better across silver_bob, pink_twinbraids, and green_glasses for arms_crossed/hand_chest/pointing. Alpha is still delegated to 02; final promotion needs user QA and alpha/RenPy QA.
